name: OWASP Desktop App Security Top 10
source_notes: IDs and names verified from index.md in the OWASP www-project-desktop-app-security-top-10 repo (front-matter level 2).
caveats: url is the OWASP GitHub repo; the rendered owasp.org page URL was not verified in the notes.
Only IDs and names were captured; summaries paraphrase the names, and prevention/detection are empty.
Maturity 'incubator' is inferred from front-matter level 2. The list dates from 2021 and may be stale.

items.name: Injections
items.summary: Untrusted input reaches interpreters or commands in a desktop application.

items.name: Broken Authentication & Session Management
items.summary: Weak authentication or session handling lets attackers assume other identities.

items.name: Sensitive Data Exposure
items.summary: Sensitive data is exposed at rest or in transit.

items.name: Improper Cryptography Usage
items.summary: Cryptography is missing, weak or misused.

items.name: Improper Authorization
items.summary: Authorization checks are missing or flawed.

items.name: Security Misconfiguration
items.summary: Insecure configuration or defaults weaken the application.

items.name: Insecure Communication
items.summary: Network communication is not adequately protected.

items.name: Using Components with Known Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Third-party components with known vulnerabilities are used.

items.name: Insufficient Logging & Monitoring
items.summary: Security events are not adequately logged or monitored.
